question: Can an invited guest read an internal document today?
answer: No. Guests currently cannot read internal documents; seven-day access is only a proposal.
quote: Approved policy: members can read internal documents. Guests cannot read internal documents. Public documents can be read by everyone.
rows: Approved policy: members can read internal documents.
Selected documents for seven days; not approved
Proposed change: invited guests could read selected internal documents for seven days. This proposal is not approved and must not be treated as current access.
Public documents can be read by everyone.
